name: How long does stucco texturing take to complete?

mainEntity.name: How long does stucco texturing take to complete?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration for stucco texturing depends on the size of the area, the complexity of the chosen texture, and weather conditions. For an average-sized home, the process can typically take anywhere from 3 to 7 days. This includes preparation, application of multiple coats, and drying time between layers. Larger or more intricate projects may require additional time to ensure a high-quality, lasting finish.
